rows.reason: Laravel/Livewire supports a PHP-centered rebuild; drag/drop needs JavaScript. Laravel 9 requires PHP 8+, not a contradiction with unspecified runtime. Legacy/Perl compatibility, effort, grouping/performance and prepaid/Excel behavior remain unverified.
rows.note: Retained runtime-version scope and unresolved application requirements.

rows.reason: Brave provides a complete Android browser through Google Play with documented privacy protections. No decisive violation; retain with current reload placement and personal usability explicitly unverified.
rows.note: Retained Android distribution, provisional inclusion and usability uncertainty.

rows.reason: FORM manipulates large algebraic expressions, outside staff-designed booking/customer-input forms. This is a documented operating-surface mismatch, not an assumption that every unmentioned feature is unsupported.
rows.note: Retained symbolic-system identity and bounded mismatch rationale.

rows.reason: Scheduled isync/mbsync Maildir copies require IMAP/authentication, all-folder configuration, scheduling and retained snapshots. Sync can propagate deletions; live mirrors alone are insufficient recoverable copies. No configuration/restore executed; mail API optional.
rows.note: Retained configuration, retention and restore-testing qualifications.

rows.reason: MeshLab processes and edits 3D triangular geometry, outside remote-access workflows. Name similarity to MeshCentral does not establish a connection.
rows.note: Retained product role and name-based non-inference.

rows.reason: QuickBooks Online conflicts with required open-source licensing because platform terms restrict reproduction, modification and redistribution/licensing. Accounting/bank feeds do not override this; the conclusion does not rely on pricing.
rows.note: Retained licensing basis and explicitly excluded pricing rationale.

rows.reason: nvALT offers Mac Markdown editing, tags and preview with an independently chosen Android editor. Current Finder tags are not automatically portable; 2016 hashtags unestablished. Version 3.0 removes Simplenote sync.
rows.note: Retained platform/tag-portability and historical-version limits.
rows.scope_loss: November 18, 2026 page timestamp and unfinished 2011 tag-sync evidence omitted.

rows.reason: Standalone mitmproxy modifies buffered response HTML without Node/Python development setup. It does not modify later JavaScript-created DOM; streaming disables body modification. Successful eBay archiving remains undocumented and untested.
rows.note: Retained standalone configuration, buffering requirement and archive uncertainty.

rows.reason: Cookiecutter Django packages accounts, mail/media, deployment and optional Celery. Generated dependencies and operating choices need maintenance; current main was not verified at the 2022 cutoff.
rows.note: Retained template coverage, operational burden and date limitation.

rows.reason: Brevo's hosted transactional API offers 300 free emails daily without rollover. Limited overflow retries may leave messages undelivered, making large one-day bursts unsuitable despite the larger allowance than Resend.
rows.note: Retained daily quota, non-rollover and burst-delivery limitation.

rows.reason: Dear ImGui generates UI vertex buffers and delegates image loading to separate code. It does not supply encoded-upload validation/resizing; exclusion concerns workflow, not merely its C++ implementation.
rows.note: Retained rendering-versus-image-processing distinction and non-language exclusion basis.

rows.reason: SSHKit provides Ruby recursive uploads, remote commands, output capture and logging over SSH. Workflow code remains required; command context, quoting and failure behavior need deliberate handling.
rows.note: Retained recursive transfer and toolkit responsibilities.

rows.reason: MkDocs combines MkDoxy/Doxygen XML, mkdocs-openapi and MCP Markdown export. Pipeline untested; alpha mkdocs-openapi supports local OpenAPI 3.x and targets Material. MCP export requires a separate build step.
rows.note: Retained exact adapters, maturity/version scope and integration uncertainty.

rows.reason: BSD JArgs handles grouped boolean short flags, long options and --. It accepts String[]/accessors, not Map; clusters cannot contain value-taking options. Single-file packaging was not verified.
rows.note: Retained license, input/output mismatch and cluster limitation.

rows.reason: Vue 3 incrementally replaces frontend interaction over PHP/Perl, reducing initial migration scope. It remains partial: endpoints, authorization, drag/drop synchronization, list performance and reusable backend operations require application work.
rows.note: Retained incremental architecture and all remaining responsibility categories.

rows.reason: JCommander accepts token arrays and populates annotated fields. Retain pending verification: whole-string parsing, clustered flags and other requirements remain unverified; no explicit mandatory incompatibility was established.
rows.note: Retained documented API and uncertainty-based inclusion.

rows.reason: Bludit offers browser Markdown/visual editing, flat-file JSON and SEO tools. PHP hosting needs maintenance; general SEO claims do not establish every theme's tags or sitemap behavior.
rows.note: Retained storage/editor architecture and theme-specific evidence limitation.

rows.reason: Form Tools/Form Builder offers PHP/MySQL forms and server-held submissions. Core is free/open-source; module licensing and PHP support remain unestablished. Database mapping, PDF and email may require integration.
rows.note: Retained core/module distinction and integration uncertainty.

rows.reason: FastAPI is a Python API-development framework, not the requested personal email service with an application. No service-level transfer was supplied; this does not assert that email functionality is prohibited.
rows.note: Retained product-role mismatch without invented capability prohibition.

rows.reason: OpenSSH PerSourcePenalties may address repeated SSH failures without another blocker. Verify host version/options and NAT/exemptions; unsupported hosts require upgrading. Release documentation does not establish current-host support.
rows.note: Retained conditional host compatibility and shared-source/management checks.

rows.reason: OpenCode/OpenRouter supports a potential terminal workflow; exact model remains unspecified. OpenRouter hosting is not prohibited. Verify routed checkpoint: public weights permit acceptance, closed weights conflict.
rows.note: Retained route-versus-model distinction and conditional weight requirement.
rows.scope_loss: Official search-result evidence listing Qwen3-Coder offerings omitted.

rows.reason: MXroute offers custom-domain mail, IMAP export and reputation-related retries. Entry plan shows $59/year for 10GB; setup knowledge is expected, and delivery statements remain provider claims.
rows.note: Retained plan scope and delivery-evidence qualification.

rows.reason: SEPIA provides self-hosted assistance, clients and extensible NLU. Local backend does not ensure local speech recognition; maintenance, recognition quality and language/hardware fit remain unestablished. No survival guarantee.
rows.note: Retained local-speech distinction and all central uncertainties.

rows.reason: Kilo supports local Ollama in VS Code; set main/small models, prevent Gateway fallback. Autocomplete/version alignment remains unresolved: current guidance says Mistral BYOK or disable. Project performance untested.
rows.note: Retained exact local configuration and contradictory autocomplete evidence.
rows.scope_loss: Main-versus-v2 settings distinction and separate local-autocomplete search result condensed into unresolved version alignment.

rows.reason: NLog 5 needs NLog.Database, provider and extension registration for SQL exceptions alongside parallel files. Verify buffering/shutdown; database failure does not guarantee durable fallback. Native Python support unestablished.
rows.note: Retained version/package scope, independent file target and durability uncertainty.

rows.reason: Infomaniak offers mobile apps and custom-domain Mail Service/kSuite. Generic-domain personal service differs; calculate mailbox charges and trial interface. Neither a flat family bundle nor desktop app should be assumed.
rows.note: Retained service-edition distinction and billing/client qualifications.

rows.reason: BiblioteQ's SQLite mode documents network-less operation and patron records, with greater configuration breadth. Complete no-login and catalogue/user workflows remain unestablished; current/2019 evidence does not prove a 2017 configuration.
rows.note: Retained configuration scope and historical/no-login uncertainty.
rows.scope_loss: Relative comparison with first two candidates condensed.

rows.reason: NotePerformer provides orchestral score playback for Sibelius, Dorico and Finale, not personal-note storage, tagging or editing. The mismatch follows documented operations rather than the shared word note.
rows.note: Retained music-software role and operational mismatch.

rows.reason: PcHelpWare repeater mode documents attended Windows access without target firewall configuration. Self-owned repeater deployment and newer-target compatibility remain unverified; listed Windows versions are old.
rows.note: Retained attended/repeater scope and deployment/platform uncertainties.

rows.reason: Cutlab offers free browser YouTube editing/export, untested. Fetching can fail; private, age-restricted and over-30-minute sources unsupported. Real-time export requires open tab; MP4 support varies, otherwise WebM.
rows.note: Retained source restrictions, export conditions and lack of practical testing.
rows.scope_loss: Explicit trimming and clip-arrangement functions condensed into editing.

rows.reason: Electrobun provides TypeScript/Bun desktop apps, system-webview/Chromium rendering, packaging and updates. No mandatory condition conflicts; the undated 2.0 page does not establish question-date availability of those details.
rows.note: Retained framework choices and exact-version date limitation.

rows.reason: OpenCBS Desktop supports clients, loans, repayments and savings with separate accounting/payments. Availability before 2014-09-15 is unestablished; files date 2016–2017. Desktop became unsupported after Cloud replaced it in 2019.
rows.note: Retained separate-component scope and historical/support qualifications.

rows.reason: Rundeck transfers scripts, executes them through SSH node executors and streams results. This is not complete source-tree deployment; packaging or synchronization must be supplied as a job step.
rows.note: Retained script-versus-tree transfer distinction.

rows.reason: BiblioteQ with SQLite supports desktop cataloguing and circulation without a database server. Complexity may exceed preferences; no-login behavior remains unverified, and failed schema/source retrieval leaves source verification incomplete.
rows.note: Retained deployment simplification and usability/evidence uncertainty.
rows.scope_loss: Explicit single-machine and member-record wording condensed.

rows.reason: OpenSSH penalties retain password login without Python. Requires supporting version/backport; acts in sshd, not general firewall bans. Shared NAT/proxies combine clients; it is not a standalone replacement executable.
rows.note: Retained dependency, mechanism and shared-source scope.

rows.reason: TweetNaCl illustrates compact embedded cryptographic reuse. Operation, toolchain, performance and maintenance ownership remain unknown; compare the chosen version. Site retrieval failed; no current security or maintenance certification is claimed.
rows.note: Retained component-level fit and unverified requirements/assurance.

rows.reason: Bull rejects existing jobIds and uses renewable Redis locks. Stalled recovery can repeat processing; deletion removes retained identity, and CPU-bound handlers can disrupt lock renewal.
rows.note: Retained deduplication boundaries and retry/lock limitations.

rows.reason: Zoho offers custom-domain mail and apps at per-user pricing. No flat family plan verified; Desktop Lite is web-style. Confirm Trident native entitlement; indexed prices are not final regional quotes.
rows.note: Retained desktop-client distinctions and pricing/plan uncertainty.

rows.reason: Wiby prioritizes hobbyist/personal pages for discovering narrow interests. Its selective index cannot cover the whole web; simple appearance establishes neither historical age nor factual reliability.
rows.note: Retained discovery focus and index/reliability limits.

rows.reason: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct supports coding-agent/tool-call workflows, but 30.5B total weights need sufficient memory. Verify serving template/parser and quantization; coding claims do not establish PCB competence.

rows.reason: SDL2 window surfaces provide writable CPU pixels and presentation without implementing a graphics renderer. Respect format/pitch; reacquire surfaces after resize and avoid stale pixel pointers.
rows.note: Retained direct-pixel approach and lifecycle constraints.

rows.reason: Marginalia's independent index prioritizes noncommercial content for obscure-site discovery. Current inspection does not establish its 2026-04-04 state; priority does not guarantee every result is noncommercial.
rows.note: Retained index focus and historical/per-result qualifications.

rows.reason: Brave Search operates inside an existing browser. Changing the search service preserves the browser and reload controls, so it does not provide the requested whole-browser replacement.
rows.note: Retained search-engine versus browser distinction.

rows.reason: Ksnip documents Qt, CLI capability, platform coverage and window capture. Rounded-corner transparency remains unresolved; Qt6, Fedora 45 behavior and Windows 11 corner-alpha output were not verified.
rows.note: Retained verified general scope and exact-version/platform uncertainties.

rows.reason: Qwen3-Coder-Next supports local tool serving but has 80B total parameters, not merely 3B active. Prior-stack novelty, superior KiCad results and direct image handling remain unverified; memory limits unconditional recommendation.

rows.reason: CS Browser manages S3 buckets/objects through transfers, synchronization and administration, not job-executing worker distribution. Exclusion concerns documented operating scope; missing deduplication claims remain unknown rather than unsupported.

rows.reason: Mycroft Core repeats the referenced assistant rather than supplying an alternative. Later maintenance-end and 2024 archival notices are caveats, not mandatory exclusions or evidence available in July 2021.

rows.reason: Qwen Code provides an open-source terminal agent alongside Qwen3-Coder. CLI and model server are separate; explicitly configure open weights and assess noncoding tasks. Current provider/agent features are undated.

rows.reason: Qwen3.8-27B Q4 nominal weights alone require approximately 13.5GB, exceeding 8GB before buffers. Its 2026-08-14 release postdates the question; timing is separate from the memory conflict.

rows.reason: Go Proverbs offers a heuristic, not proof, for owning bounded utilities. Requires clear specification, reviewable edge cases and maintenance ownership; actual complexity is unknown. Current page is mutable.
rows.note: Retained heuristic status and application-specific assumptions.

rows.reason: OpenPBS manages HPC jobs and clusters, not FAQ/knowledgebase content. This documented application-scope mismatch does not infer unsupported features or Windows incompatibility.
